dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, high-contrast light-colored rings with jagged perimeters are visible on the mid-dorsal and lateral surfaces; a prominent closed 'O' shape sits centrally with jagged transitions to the darker surrounding coat.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Scattered small, high-intensity white punctate marks are present primarily along the dorsal-lateral transition zone, particularly near the neck and anterior to the primary annuli, lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary geometric relationship forms an obtuse triangle connecting the centroid of the large central annulus to a smaller secondary annulus inferior to it and a cluster of high-intensity blobs located cranially.

other_distinctive_markers: Complex interlocking network of thin, high-contrast white filaments connecting the macro-annuli, creating a web-like appearance on the dorsal-lateral surface.
